text:
nova: quick ping — saw invoice-preview drop to zero for a handful of tenants during the tombstone prune run at 14:30 UTC. preview recovered after ~80s. filing here for triage.

cheng: sample tenant/trace? my hunch is tombstone/rebind ordering with our dedupe key including route_version.

rachel: tenant=glass-hq trace=`tr-kt9f`. ingest excerpt:
```
2024-08-15T14:29:58Z INFO route-resolver tombstone route=r45->removed
2024-08-15T14:30:00Z WARN quota-heartbeat gap tenant=glass-hq window=60s
2024-08-15T14:30:01Z INFO metering-event tokens=46 route=r46 fingerprint=fp-33b session=s-12
```

cheng: dedupe key used in preview path = `tenant|fingerprint|route_version`. When tombstone prunes the old route we sometimes briefly flip versions and order of events causes the preview aggregator to think there's a gap. final billing (post-rollup) aligns, so this is preview-only noise.

nova: product wants SKU-level previews visible. can't drop route_version from dedupe globally.

rachel: suggestion: implement a preview-only "tombstone alias" mapping at ingest: when a route is tombstoned or rebound, and we see events in same session/fingerprint within TTL (90s), map to a canonical_preview_route (prefer last-active route before tombstone). preview dedupe uses canonical route, billing unaffected.

telemetry-bot: chart: quota-heartbeat-jitter spike 14:27-14:32 (dash link: http://dash/heartbeat?from=14:00&to=15:00)

infra-bot: NOTE: partition-5 consumer-lag 14:29-14:31 max=13s. tombstone job ran at 14:29:59.

cheng: pseudocode:
```
key = tenant+"|"+session+"|"+fingerprint
if event.route_tombstoned and map[key] exists and now < map[key].expires:
  emit.preview_route = map[key].canonical
else if route_flip and within_TTL:
  map[key] = {canonical: previous_route, expires: now+TTL}
  emit.preview_route = map[key].canonical
else:
  emit.preview_route = observed_route
```

nova: risk: accidentally merging real retries across different routes. mitigation: only apply when session_id present AND fingerprint unchanged AND tombstone flag seen; keep TTL conservative (90s) and emit `preview_tombstone_alias` for audit.

pm-kai: UX ask: add a small tooltip on preview panel: "Preview may group transient route tombstones/rebinds for clarity; invoices are unaffected." Also show a dot indicating how many events were canonicalized in the preview window.

rachel: telemetry: we'll emit `preview_tombstone_alias` events and metric `preview_tombstone_alias_count` with tenant tag. dashboard: add per-tenant sparkline on preview panel.

cheng: rollout plan: behind flag `preview_tombstone_alias`. canary 1% tenants for 2h, watch `invoice_preview_gap_pct`, `preview_tombstone_alias_count`, and final billing diffs.

nova: QA: unit tests for tombstone vs normal flips, integration test ingest->preview with tombstone timing jitter, ensure no cross-tenant leakage.

pm-kai: product will prepare tooltip copy and coordinate EAP messaging for canary.

nova: ok assigning: cheng = impl + PR, rachel = telemetry + logs, kai = UX copy. will post PR and canary link here. thanks team :thumbsup:
